patterns.name: Turning field
patterns.description: Intact seven-dot clusters turn through four visible orientations at three sizes. A modular repeat with a changing direction.
patterns.title: {name} / Turning field / supporting study

patterns.name: North current
patterns.description: Clusters travel in alternating streams, swelling and receding as they pass. A calm directional repeat for larger surfaces.
patterns.title: {name} / North current / supporting study

patterns.name: Drift lines
patterns.description: Individual circles follow gentle, interleaved waves. A light texture for a cover margin, document back or digital panel.
patterns.title: {name} / Drift lines / supporting study

patterns.name: Ring lattice
patterns.description: Hollow circles keep the original seven-dot spacing while opening the pattern. Alternating turns form an airy lattice.
patterns.title: {name} / Ring lattice / supporting study

patterns.name: Overscale
patterns.description: Large clusters meet the edge of the tile. Broad, rounded forms suit covers, wraps and environmental graphics.
patterns.title: {name} / Overscale / supporting study

patterns.name: Wind rose
patterns.description: Seven-dot clusters circulate around a clear centre, with smaller dots extending the rhythm. A focal composition rather than a repeat.
patterns.title: {name} / Wind rose / supporting study

patterns.name: Dot canopy
patterns.description: A field of changing circle sizes opens into a soft central clearing. A supporting texture for a quiet title or a photograph.
patterns.title: {name} / Dot canopy / supporting study

patterns.name: Seven grid
patterns.description: Small clusters keep one direction and one scale. A restrained repeat for borders, stationery and reverse sides.
patterns.title: {name} / Seven grid / supporting study
